name: Physical Camera
summary: Captures a finite batch from a connected OpenCV camera, then processes the saved images.

device_id.label: Camera device ID
device_id.description: Nonnegative OpenCV camera index. Camera resolution is selected by the device/backend.

output_dir.label: Capture output directory
output_dir.description: Each execution creates a new capture-* subfolder here. Existing captures are retained.

frame_count.label: Frames to capture
frame_count.description: Positive finite frame count. Capture completes before pipeline processing; continuous capture is not supported in workflows.
